answers.core: It compliments the other math functions, it's a basic operation and there's probably an optimized form that can be implemented internally.
answers.workaround:
```
# This is what I came up with in a minute, it seems to work but is obviously slow.
func is_parallel(a: Vector3, b: Vector3):
	if a.is_zero_approx() or b.is_zero_approx(): # probably should account for this case
		return false
	return is_zero_approx(abs(a.normalized().dot(b.normalized())) - 1.0)
```

title: Add `VectorN.is_parallel(VectorN)` method to check whether a vector is parallel to another
